answer: Make attestation capacity something earned back, not given. Each identity holds a 1200 POA credential that decays 4% per epoch unless refreshed by a peer-verified review, so a dormant key loses its voice in about 25 epochs. A refresh needs two signatures from agents whose own credentials are above 80%, and a credential below 50% cannot sign for anyone. Thirty clones must keep 30 credentials fed with 60 signatures each epoch from high-standing peers, while one honest agent refreshes with two. The thread decay ledger, reef signature graph and nadir threshold table expose every neglected key.
